votes.motion: To approve minutes from the August 9, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting as presented.
To approve application #PAM2021-000364 requesting approval to Amend the Kinikini Subdivision Plat to combine lots 5, 6, and 7 with staff recommendations as presented.

To recommend approval of application #CUP2021-000394 requesting a Conditional Use Permit for a revised site plan expanding the existing Carrington Square fitness center and pool area to the Kearns Council with staff recommendations as presented. [OAM2021-000271]

To recommend approval of file #OAM2021-000271 - A proposal to amend Chapter 19.15 of the Kearns Municipal Code which allows for and regulates Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs) to conform to Kearns Metro Township Planning Commission – September 13, 2021 – Meeting Summary requirements regarding Internal Accessory Dwelling Units mandated by state legislation to the Kearns Metro Township Council with amendments to lot sizes in 19.15.030 and delete B from 19.15.070.
